question: For Atezolizumab trials, bucket the publication year into: ≤2014, 2015–2018, ≥2019.
generated_sql:
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN "Year" <= 2014 THEN '<=2014'
        WHEN "Year" >= 2015 AND "Year" <= 2018 THEN '2015-2018'
        WHEN "Year" >= 2019 THEN '>=2019'
        ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS "Year Group",
    COUNT(*)
FROM compat.clinical_trials
WHERE "Name of ICI" = 'Atezolizumab'
GROUP BY "Year Group"
